verdict.rationale: Fenwick ships client-facing technology through Fenwick Labs, extranets and AI tools, so a buyer could fairly ask about user-configurable background automations. However, the evidence only shows firm-built automatic behaviors: auto-synced trademark dockets, intelligent patent alerts, and automated document generation. Nothing shows a user setting up their own autonomous automations, and probes found no API or llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
